gpt.rationale: The mostly fear/sadness/surprise sequence fits an introverted girl’s subdued panic and quiet unease, with only a few surprise tags feeling a bit broad where a more muted shock or wary concern would fit better.

claude.rationale: Sprites track the line emotions well (fear, surprise, sadness in coherent arc), but the relentless overt fear/surprise undercuts the reserved, subtle introvert who keeps strong feelings inside.
